concerns.text: Task T008 records the paired two‑sided t‑test p‑value but does **not enforce** the FR‑004 requirement that the reported p‑value be > 0.05. The specification states the system MUST report a p‑value > 0.05, implying the pipeline should verify this condition (and possibly trigger fallback or raise an error if not). The current task only stores the p‑value, which weakens the functional requirement.
